title: Shiny.Obd emulator profile
description: A vehicle, driving scenarios and starting state for the Shiny.Obd.Emulator OBD-II adapter emulator. Every section is optional, so a file can carry just a vehicle, just a scenario, or a fault state to apply on top of whatever vehicle is selected. Load with ObdEmulatorProfile.Parse / Load and apply with ApplyTo.

$schema.description: Lets editors find this schema. Ignored by the emulator.

formatVersion.description: The version of this format. The emulator refuses a file newer than it understands rather than half-applying it.

scenarios.description: Driving scenarios to add to the player. A scenario with the same name as an existing one replaces it.

pid.description: A mode or PID as two hex digits, e.g. "0D".

dtc.description: A SAE J2012 trouble code, e.g. "P0301". The second character is 0-3 - only two bits carry it on the wire.

hexBytes.description: Raw bytes as hex pairs, spaces allowed, e.g. "02 00". Empty clears it.

vehicle.description: A vehicle the emulator can be (EmulatedVehicle). Selecting it rewrites the identity PIDs, which PIDs are supported, the readiness monitor set and the fault memory.

name.description: How the vehicle is named, e.g. "2018 Honda Civic LX".

vin.description: Answered to mode 09 PID 02. 17 characters, no I, O or Q. Use a real WMI and descriptor with a valid check digit if the app under test decodes VINs - a made-up one decodes to nothing.

decodes.description: What a VIN decode should come back with, so the app under test has something to check against.

note.description: Why this vehicle exists - the case it covers.

fuelTypeCode.description: Mode 01 PID 51, the J1979 fuel type. 1 gasoline, 4 diesel, 8 electric, 17 hybrid gasoline.

obdStandard.description: Mode 01 PID 1C. 1 CARB OBD-II, 6 EOBD, 7 EOBD and OBD-II, 10 JOBD.

ethanolPercent.description: Mode 01 PID 52. Non-zero only on a flex-fuel vehicle.

hybridBatteryPercent.description: Mode 01 PID 5B. Leave at 0 and list 5B in unsupportedPids on a vehicle with no traction battery.

compressionIgnition.description: Reports the compression-ignition (diesel) readiness monitor set.

unsupportedPids.description: Mode 01 PIDs this vehicle does not answer. They drop out of the supported-PID masks and a read gets NO DATA.

reportsVehicleInformation.description: Whether mode 09 is answered at all. False on an early OBD-II vehicle, where the VIN, calibration ID and ECU name all come back NO DATA.

storedDtcs.description: Fault memory the vehicle starts with (mode 03). The MIL is lit when any are present.

freezeFrameDtc.description: The code the stored freeze frame was captured against. Null when no freeze frame is stored.

massKg.description: Kerb mass plus a driver, in kg.

displacementLitres.description: Engine displacement in litres. Mass air flow is computed from it.

peakPowerWatts.description: Peak power in watts. Caps tractive force at speed.

peakTractiveForceN.description: Peak tractive force in newtons. Caps acceleration at low speed.

idleRpm.description: Warm idle speed. 0 on an EV.

tankLitres.description: Tank size in litres - turns a fuel rate into a falling fuel level.

gearRatios.description: Engine rpm per km/h in each gear, top gear last.

fuelDensityGramsPerLitre.description: Fuel density in g/L - 745 petrol, 832 diesel.

isElectric.description: No engine to model: speed still moves, but the engine PIDs are meaningless.

scenario.description: A named drive the emulator can play back (DrivingScenario).

loops.description: Restart from the first step when the last one ends.

action.description: How speed is driven toward targetSpeedKph. For brake, harshBrake and coast the target is a floor.

seconds.description: How long the step runs, whether or not the target was reached.

state.description: Overrides applied after the vehicle is selected. Anything left out keeps its current value.

adapterIdentifier.description: What the adapter answers to ATI. Include "STN" to exercise the OBDLink profile.

deviceDescription.description: What the adapter answers to AT@1.

monitorsComplete.description: False reports the readiness monitors as still running - what fails an inspection.

freezeFrameCaptured.description: Whether a mode 02 snapshot exists. False answers every freeze frame read with NO DATA.

engineOff.description: Answer every request with NO DATA, as an adapter does with the ignition off.

parameters.description: Per-PID values. Set the field that matches the parameter's kind: number for scalars (engineering units), text for ASCII PIDs (VIN, ECU name), hex for bitfield PIDs.

supported.description: False makes the PID answer NO DATA and drop out of the supported masks.

number.description: The value in engineering units, e.g. 88 for 88 km/h.

rawOverride.description: Payload bytes sent instead of the encoded value - for composite or deliberately malformed replies. Empty clears it.
